newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Matrix says no funding changes planned.
newsitem.headline: Matrix says no funding changes planned.

text.p: Matrix Telecommunications Ltd said on Tuesday that it had not finalised any funding proposals following its annual budget review.
The company said an article in today's edition of the Australian Financial Review newspaper had wrongly suggested that the terms of a proposal had been completed.

"In the course of its annual budgeting review, the Matrix Telecommunications group had instituted a review of its funding options, including both debt and equity funding. The article is incorrect in its suggestion that the terms of any proposal have been finalised," the company told the Australian Stock Exchange which had placed a trading halt against the stock pending the announcement.
"At this time there is no proposal which is sufficiently firm to require announcement to the market. The company will make an announcement in due course if a firm proposal is completed," it said.

The newspaper said Matrix, which has San Francisco investment group Hellman and Friedman and Kerry Packer's Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd as major shareholders, was looking to raise A$100 million through a private placement to expand its operations in Asia.
It said the company was proposing a placement of 36 million shares at A$2.00 each and a rights issue of 14 million shares at the same price.
